name: notify
description: Send a notification to a user or channel on an external platform (Discord, etc.). Use this to proactively alert people about task completion, errors, or important updates. Provide either 'username' for user-based targeting (sends to all linked channels) or 'channel_type' + 'channel_id' for direct targeting. Do not combine both.

message.description: The notification content (max 2000 chars). Discord mentions are supported: <@USER_ID>, <@&ROLE_ID>, @everyone, and @here, subject to Discord permissions.

username.description: Turnstone username to notify. Sends to all linked channels for this user.

channel_id.description: Platform-specific channel or user ID for direct targeting.

title.description: Optional short title for the notification.
